entities.summary: Jewish exile who rose to prominence in the Babylonian and Persian courts (c. 605–536 BCE). His interpretations of Nebuchadnezzar's dreams and his apocalyptic visions of four world empires and the "Son of Man" profoundly shaped Jewish and Christian eschatology.
